description: This file contains unit tests for the IDGeneratorDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It tests methods like getCurrentID and updateNextId to ensure they behave correctly for various entity classes such as Employee, Module, and User.

classes.name: IDGeneratorDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for IDGeneratorDao, testing ID generation and update functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, sets up the IDGeneratorDao instance and loads test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetCurrentID
methods.description: Tests that the getCurrentID method returns expected default values for various entity classes.

methods.name: testUpdateNextId
methods.description: Tests that the updateNextId method correctly updates and retrieves the next ID for an entity class.
